prompt:
I need the front end for Hearthvale Companion. The official companion app for Hearthvale, a cozy village-building mobile game with tens of millions of casual players, that keeps track of a player's village while they're away.

Who's using it: Priya Nand, a night-shift pharmacy technician who plays Hearthvale for 10–15 minutes at a time on breaks. She's in a casual friends' guild and hates being pestered by her phone.

What they're doing right now: It's 2:40am on her break. She just got a burst of six alerts at once and wants to see what actually changed in her village since 10pm, decide what's worth doing in the remaining 12 minutes, and cut back what interrupts her so that only the guild event deadline and trade requests from her two closest friends get through during her shift.

What's in the system at this point: Village 'Plumhollow', level 34. Since 10:02pm: 3 crop plots finished (pumpkins ×40 at 11:15pm, lavender ×25 at 1:30am, wheat ×60 at 2:05am; pumpkins spoil in 4h). Bakery queue: 2 of 5 pies done. Guild 'Moss & Mischief' (18 members) 'Harvest Moon Festival' event: 6,420 of 10,000 points, ends in 1h 52m, Priya has contributed 410. Trade requests: from 'June_bug' (wants 10 lavender for 1 golden egg) and from stranger 'xXFarmlordXx'. Limited shop restocks at 4:00am. Current alert settings: 14 categories, all on, with quiet hours off. Friend tiers: 2 close friends, 23 others.

Build it as a working web app, opened in the state that person would see at that moment. No backend: use realistic mock data (no lorem ipsum, no placeholder names), and make the interactive parts actually work client-side.

Use whatever framework and tooling you like. When you're done there must be a static production build in ./out with ./out/index.html as the entry point. It will be served from the root of a plain static file server (no rewrites, no server code) and viewed in a desktop browser at 1440×900.
